Here's the result of running `cat -n` on /app/test/03-list-operations.scm:
     1	;; Test 3: List operations - Working with cons cells
     2	
     3	;; List creation and manipulation
     4	(define lst '(1 2 3 4 5))
     5	;; Original list
     6	(display lst)
     7	(newline)
     8	
     9	;; Custom length function
    10	(define (my-length lst)
    11	  (if (null? lst)
    12	      0
    13	      (+ 1 (my-length (cdr lst)))))
    14	
    15	;; Length of list
    16	(display (my-length lst))
    17	(newline)
    18	
    19	;; Reverse a list
    20	(define (reverse lst)
    21	  (define (reverse-iter lst acc)
    22	    (if (null? lst)
    23	        acc
    24	        (reverse-iter (cdr lst) (cons (car lst) acc))))
    25	  (reverse-iter lst '()))
    26	
    27	;; Reversed list
    28	(display (reverse lst))
    29	(newline)
    30	
    31	;; Map function
    32	(define (my-map f lst)
    33	  (if (null? lst)
    34	      '()
    35	      (cons (f (car lst)) (my-map f (cdr lst)))))
    36	
    37	;; Squared values
    38	(display (my-map (lambda (x) (* x x)) lst))
    39	(newline)
    40	
    41	;; Filter function
    42	(define (filter pred lst)
    43	  (cond ((null? lst) '())
    44	        ((pred (car lst)) (cons (car lst) (filter pred (cdr lst))))
    45	        (else (filter pred (cdr lst)))))
    46	
    47	;; Even numbers from list
    48	(display (filter (lambda (x) (= (- x (* 2 (/ x 2))) 0)) lst))
    49	(newline)
